name: Semi-Analytical Volume Rendering with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A volume rendering method that reconstructs the scalar field inside a hexahedral cell as a third-degree polynomial in ray parameter t using trilinear interpolation coefficients, allowing for analytical integration of the volume rendering equation.
summary: Semi-analytical volume rendering with trilinear interpolation eliminates topological artifacts in hexahedral cells by analytically determining optimal sampling points based on signal extrema.
